home.manifesto: I walk alongside women who want to make hairstyling part of their path and begin building their own way of creating and working.
studio: I prefer to understand hair rather than try to dominate it. I do not pursue perfection; I seek coherence between the person, the design and the intention.
I am interested in design, architecture, art, nature and the psychology of perception. Inspiration rarely comes from another hairstyle. It usually comes from learning to see the world.
I do not want to have more. I want to deeply understand what I use. I prefer few products, few tools and conscious decisions. Simplicity is also a way of respecting the craft.
Designing a hairstyle means resolving a series of small decisions with sensitivity. Creativity appears when curiosity, observation and experience work together.
